anomalies.description: A person is seen holding and aiming a revolver through vertical bars; the gun is clearly visible in multiple frames as being gripped and pointed forward, consistent with preparation to fire.

A physical altercation occurs in a dimly lit hallway: one person in white is tackled or pushed to the floor while another individual runs toward them; the scene escalates into close-quarters struggle.; A person in a white shirt is seen running down a hallway while being pursued or engaged by another figure; motion blur and posture suggest active physical confrontation or chase.
In a bedroom, a person in a white shirt appears to be forcefully restraining or striking a shirtless person lying on a bed, suggesting an attack on a vulnerable individual.

A person is seen holding a handgun and pointing it directly forward, with the muzzle clearly visible and aligned toward the camera/viewer; this constitutes visual evidence of an imminent or ongoing shooting action.

A person seated on a bench is attacked by another individual who leans over and appears to strike or subdue them; the seated person is visibly restrained and unable to resist as others gather closely around.

A person is seated on a bench while two others physically restrain and assault them; one leans over aggressively, another appears to strike or hold the victim down. The victim is in a vulnerable, immobilized position.

Multiple individuals engage in physical struggle around the bench: one person is pulled or pushed off the bench onto the ground, while others grapple and pull at each other in close contact, indicating mutual combat among at least two parties.; After the initial assault, multiple individuals engage in chaotic physical struggle: one person is on the ground near the bench, others are moving rapidly, grabbing, and running—indicating mutual combat among at least three parties.

After the initial assault, a group of people (at least 4–5) flee rapidly down the cobblestone street in apparent panic or coordinated dispersal, with some carrying objects; background shows chaotic movement and vehicle headlights approaching, suggesting collective violent unrest or aftermath of a clash.
